name_resolution.rationale: TaiCOL returned no exact species record. Tai2 has an exact non-Taiwanese species record for Helleborus viridis L. and identifies the genus as 鐵筷子屬, but its species-level Chinese-name fields are blank. Kew POWO independently confirms Helleborus viridis L. as accepted and gives only the English vernacular green hellebore. Because Taiwan's exact public record supplies no Chinese species name, the result remains unresolved instead of manufacturing 綠鐵筷子 or another translation.

Preserve Helleborus viridis or green hellebore when needed; do not present 綠鐵筷子, 綠嚏根草, or another literal translation as a Taiwan public plant name without a source.
